name: The deployment shape
owner: the vendor's published words, read on a date, with a hash, and never probed
smallest: a scope, a flag or a line on a documentation page
status_note: A shape today carries its tools, its reach names and the route each row goes through, as strings in a profile file. None of them is a node. This is the first universe where the vocabulary is not this site's: a vendor speaks in scopes, tool names, flags, consent screens and administrator settings, and the ABP keeps them in the vendor's words and draws an edge from each to the primitive it exposes.

node_types.name: Product
node_types.formula: a node that -has_variant-> at least one [DeploymentShape]

node_types.name: DeploymentShape
node_types.formula: [DeploymentShape] := a node that -grants-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: Tool
node_types.formula: a node that a [DeploymentShape] -runs_with-> and that -exposes-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: Scope
node_types.formula: a node that a [Tool] or [DeploymentShape] is -scoped_by->, in the vendor's own identifier

node_types.name: Setting
node_types.formula: a node that -moves-> a [Barrier] on at least one [GrantedCapability]
node_types.note: The confirmations flag is the published case: one Setting node moving one Barrier is what the home page's pair of examples shows.

node_types.name: DocumentationPage
node_types.formula: a [SourceFile] in U0 that a [Shape], [Tool], [Scope] or [Setting] is -documented_at->

node_types.name: Contradiction
node_types.formula: a node where an -advertises-> claim and a -scoped_by-> scope on the same [Product] disagree, both quoted, both dated, published unresolved
node_types.note: riskmandate.ai's Lab 01 holds four of these with verbatim quotes and URLs.

verbs.inverse_reads_as: this variant is a variant of this product

verbs.reads_as: this shape runs with this tool
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this tool is run by these shapes
this capability is exposed by these tools

verbs.reads_as: this tool is scoped by this vendor scope

verbs.inverse_reads_as: this barrier is moved by this setting

verbs.reads_as: this tool is documented at this page, read on this date
this product's page advertises this capability
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this capability is advertised by these products

verbs.reads_as: this advertised claim contradicts this granted scope
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this scope is contradicted by this claim

verbs.reads_as: this deployment shape grants this capability
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this capability is granted by this deployment shape

adds: The position on a connector that is present and switched off, which is the most common state in any real estate. The enforcer test decides it: if the switch is inside the agent's grant, the capability is in the grant at barrier setting, one click away, and the label counts it; if the switch is outside the grant, the capability is not in the grant, and the estate in U9 records it as one setting away. No new barrier kind and no new label field. The seven shapes riskmandate.ai has already built are layer one facts and belong at this address, through an intake path that carries their provenance.

provenance.note: The universe is authored in admin/build/universes.py; the matched counts and the live junctions are computed from the graph on every build.
